Container.Name: seerrcompanion
Container.Overview: Seerr companion: trims multi-season requests to the first season and marks unwatched series for deletion, with a web UI to approve or keep.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds the state database and web UI secret.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web UI port.

Config.Name: SEERR_URL
Config.Description: Seerr base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.2:5055.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Seerr admin API key (Settings -> General).

Config.Name: WEBUI_USERNAME
Config.Description: Web UI login username; the UI is off unless this and the password are set.

Config.Name: WEBUI_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Web UI login password.

Config.Name: DRY_RUN
Config.Description: true = log only, change and delete nothing; set false to go live.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_URL
Config.Description: Tautulli base URL for watch state; blank uses Seerr's own watch data.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Tautulli API key.

Config.Name: APPRISE_URLS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Apprise notification URLs; blank logs only.

Config.Name: WEBUI_URL
Config.Description: Public URL of this web UI, added to notifications as a review link.

Config.Name: SEERR_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Seerr URL for title links in the UI, if SEERR_URL is internal.

Config.Name: TRIM_SEASONS
Config.Description: Trim pending multi-season TV requests to the first season.

Config.Name: APPROVE_AFTER_TRIM
Config.Description: Approve a request after trimming it.

Config.Name: FLAG_UNWATCHED
Config.Description: Mark a user's unwatched series for deletion when they request another title.

Config.Name: PURGE_AFTER_DAYS
Config.Description: Auto-delete flagged titles after this many days; blank never auto-deletes.

Config.Name: IGNORE_USER_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Seerr user IDs to skip.

Config.Name: POLL_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between Seerr polls.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. Europe/London.
